comparison.objective: Probes a passing pallet; candidate fractures and recovers installed-insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed contact with a moving pallet differs from sustained coaxial mandrel stabilization, separately manipulated hammering, and fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: Successful probing is title-supported; target, force, and timing thresholds are absent. Candidate requires four notch fractures, contained fragments, and intact retained components.
comparison.reason: Although both use tool contact, probing does not establish the candidate’s bimanual impact-fracture-and-recovery ability.
